# Focus Lab

> Focus Lab is a product company based in Islamabad, Pakistan. We design, build,
> and operate our own software — Urban Events, WorkProof, and Fixer — and take
> on a limited amount of partner work when the fit is right.

Contact: bilal@focuslab.pk · +92 333 5507394 (call or WhatsApp: https://wa.me/923335507394) · Islamabad, Pakistan
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/110646093/

## Products

All three products are Focus Lab's own: we design, build, and operate them.
Each product's website is the source of truth for details and pricing; the
site links to them directly (and `/products/<slug>` redirects there).

- [Urban Events](https://urbanevents.focuslab.pk): ticketing for Pakistan. Publish a branded event page, sell tickets in PKR via JazzCash, Easypaisa, and bank transfer, and check guests in by QR from any phone. Free for free events; 5% per paid ticket, settled in PKR, with weekly payouts.
- [WorkProof](https://workproof.focuslab.pk): self-hosted workforce activity analytics. Active vs. idle, focus ratio, and per-person rollups computed on your own server. Captures what anyone types? Never. Domains, never full URLs; screenshots opt-in; audit log and CSV. Pricing on request, per person, billed annually.
- [Fixer](https://fixer.focuslab.pk): production logs in, draft pull requests out. Connects to 24 log sources, isolates the exceptions worth a human, investigates against your code, and opens a draft pull request with a root cause and proposed fix. Draft PRs only — a human reviews and merges; the GitHub App has no merge permission. Bring your own model key, or self-host on your Cloudflare account.

## Pages

- [Home](https://focuslab.pk/): the numbered stream of product launches and studio notes.
- [Stream](https://focuslab.pk/stream/): the same 17 entries, searchable.
- Products link straight from the site navigation — Urban Events, WorkProof, and Fixer each open their own website.
- [Studio](https://focuslab.pk/studio/): who we are and how we work.
- [Stack](https://focuslab.pk/stack/): the tools we build with.
- [Thoughts](https://focuslab.pk/thoughts/): curated external writing we find useful (20 links, attributed).
- [Podcast](https://focuslab.pk/podcast/): curated external shows from Pakistan (10 shows, ~25 episodes, attributed).
- [Books](https://focuslab.pk/books/): 23 books — product, entrepreneurship, and Pakistan — that shaped how we build.
- [Jobs](https://focuslab.pk/jobs/): working at Focus Lab. [Jobs feed](https://focuslab.pk/feed/jobs.xml).
- [Policies](https://focuslab.pk/policies/): terms, privacy, security, and the rest, in plain language.
- [Contact](https://focuslab.pk/contact/): start a conversation.
- Site-wide feed: [RSS](https://focuslab.pk/rss.xml).

## The stream

The homepage is the numbered feed; `/stream/` is the searchable archive.
There are 17 entries, at `/01` … `/17`. Each entry is self-contained and is
one of two kinds:

- `note` — a studio note or partner update
- `launch` — a product launch or product update

Current entries, newest first:

| Num | Kind | Date | Title |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 01 | note | 2026-09-22 | Start here |
| 02 | note | 2026-11-12 | Warp N Woof — luxury women's wear on Shopify |
| 03 | note | 2026-11-04 | Al Qiyas Movers — a Framer site for a UAE moving company |
| 04 | launch | 2026-10-20 | Urban Events: PKR checkout, the way Pakistan pays |
| 05 | launch | 2026-09-21 | Fixer opens draft PRs for production errors |
| 06 | launch | 2026-09-14 | WorkProof: see the work, not the worker |
| 07 | launch | 2026-09-07 | Urban Events: ticketing for Pakistan |
| 08 | note | 2026-08-24 | Products first, partners occasionally |
| 09 | launch | 2026-03-03 | WorkProof: enrolled in under a minute |
| 10 | launch | 2026-02-10 | Urban Events: QR check-in at the door |
| 11 | launch | 2026-01-06 | Fixer: new issues, not repeated alerts |
| 12 | launch | 2025-07-01 | WorkProof: per-person rollups |

Partner work (02, 03) is delivered on the same terms as our own products.

## Adding content (for LLMs and agents)

All content lives in typed data files under `src/data/`. To add content, edit
the relevant file and follow its exported TypeScript interface:

- New stream entry → append to `stream` in `src/data/stream.ts` (keep the
  feed small; entries are numbered `01`… contiguously, newest first).
- New product → add to `products` in `src/data/products.ts` (keep copy in
  step with the live product site).
- New book → add to `books` in `src/data/books.ts`.
- New curated essay → add to `thoughts` in `src/data/thoughts.ts` (must have
  a real `url` and correct `source`).
- New curated show → add to `podcasts` in `src/data/podcast.ts`.
- New policy → add to `policies` in `src/data/policies.ts`.

Full schema, conventions, and examples: see `docs/CONTENT.md` in the repository.

## Notes

- The design uses a stable forest green (#235C43) ground, soft white
  (#F4F6F3) text, and a warm gold accent (#E8C469) for links, selection,
  and call-to-action buttons, with locally hosted variable DM Sans
  typography and monospace stream numbers. The palette is fixed; no
  page-load rotation or stored overrides.
- Jobs and policy updates prepare email requests, not automatic
  subscriptions. Visitors must open and send the draft from their own
  email app.
- sitemap.xml is generated from the build output and lists exactly the
  pages that are not marked noindex, so it cannot fall behind the routes.
- External curated links are always attributed to their source.
